prompt:
IMAGE TO VIDEO REQUEST: ONE SHORT ANIMATION CLIP.

WHAT THIS IS
A 2D sprite animation of the exact character in the attached first-frame image, preserving her exact face, proportions, hair, outfit, accessories, and hand-drawn colored pencil and ink caricature style throughout every frame.

CAMERA AND BACKGROUND
Locked static camera with zero movement. The character stays facing left with her feet planted on the exact same spot on a flat, solid pure magenta background with no shadows, lighting changes, or visual effects. Silent clip.

MOTION: SQUISHY SQUEEZE
From her starting relaxed stance, she takes a small round white dumpling-shaped squishy toy with a really cute face out of her hoodie pocket, holds it in both hands at chest height and pushes it forward toward the left once, straightening both arms as she squeezes it hard between her palms until it explodes on hit, grinning with delight. She lets it puff back up, tucks it back into her hoodie pocket and returns to her starting relaxed stance.
kept: Everything except the dumpling description in MOTION stayed exactly the same, including all rules about facing, feet, locked camera, magenta background, and silent clip.
changed: Added a really cute face to the dumpling and changed the squeeze result to explode on hit to carry both parts of his note about the toy.
note: The dumpling should explode on hit. Also, the dumpling should have a really cute face, just like the popular dumpling squishes have.
